name: ES-ReBRAC: ensemble actor + grad clip
tagline: ReBRAC with per-env tuned hyperparameters, but the actor uses the mean of both critics for the policy gradient and both actor/critic gradients are norm-clipped.

key_hyperparams.name: normalize_q
key_hyperparams.role: rescale q by 1/|mean(|Q|)| in actor loss

init_recovers: ReBRAC baseline at large grad-clip and Q1-only actor gradient
diff_from_baseline: Direct extension of the rebrac baseline: substitutes the Q1-only actor gradient with the (Q1+Q2)/2 ensemble mean and adds explicit gradient-norm clipping on both actor and critic optimizer steps.

name: UACQL: CQL + Q-disagreement scaling
tagline: CQL-style critic regularizer scaled per-batch by the normalized Q1/Q2 disagreement, plus TD3-style target smoothing and SAC entropy temperature.

key_hyperparams.name: uncertainty_scale (kappa)
key_hyperparams.role: extra weight on CQL when twin-critic disagreement is high

key_hyperparams.name: bc_loss_weight
key_hyperparams.role: extra MSE BC term in actor loss

diff_from_baseline: Adds a CQL-style critic baseline (none of the shipped baselines use CQL) that is dynamically scaled by per-state twin-critic disagreement, plus TD3 target smoothing, SAC entropy temperature, and a small MSE BC term.

name: UG-ReBRAC: uncertainty-modulated BC
tagline: ReBRAC, but the critic and actor BC penalties are multiplied by a per-state factor proportional to |Q1-Q2| relative to the batch mean, clipped to [0.5, 5].
diff_from_baseline: Extends the rebrac baseline by replacing constant actor/critic BC weights with state-dependent multipliers driven by |Q1-Q2| epistemic disagreement (clipped to [0.5x, 5x] of base).

name: DA-IQL: double-anchor IQL
tagline: Standard IQL value learning, but the critic target uses min(V(s'), 0.75 Q(s', a'_data)+0.25 V(s')) and the actor adds a temporal-consistency log-prob loss on dataset next actions.

key_hyperparams.name: anchor_mix
key_hyperparams.role: weight on Q(s',a'_data) in mixed anchor

key_hyperparams.name: temporal_bc_coef
key_hyperparams.role: weight on AWR loss at (s', a'_data)

init_recovers: IQL baseline at anchor_mix=0, policy_gap_coef=0, temporal_bc_coef=0
diff_from_baseline: Extends the iql baseline along three axes: a pessimistic min-of-(V, mixed anchor) critic target, a critic-side ReLU policy-gap regularizer that suppresses Q(s,π(s)) > Q(s,a_data), and a temporal-consistency AWR term on dataset next actions.
